data.title: Unit 12 : The solar system
How much you know?
data.text: Click the correct option for each statement.
The Earth is the only planet in the solar system that can support life.
The planet Mars has a red spot in the middle which is actually a giant storm.
There is a belt of asteroids that orbits the Sun between Mars and Jupiter.
Venus is the only planet in the solar system that takes longer to rotate on its axis then to orbit around the Sun.
Mars does not have an atmosphere as it lies very close to the Sun.

feedback.rank1: Hmm... You can do better than this.
